ticks.note: Tick 1 enters the initial state **A**; its immediate transition fires at once (x = 1) and **B** is entered. B's transition is delayed, so it is not checked in the tick B is entered, even though I is true: x stays 1.
I is still true (inputs keep their value). B was entered in an earlier tick, so its delayed transition fires now: x = 11, state C.
C has no outgoing transitions: nothing happens, x stays 11.
